purpose: Versioned provenance-bound personal payload in the Mirror without weakening Authority/Mirror evidence separation.

media.rule: Any payload class may be admitted only with explicit provenance, rights/privacy checks, bounded identity and successor semantics.

bidirectionality.engineering_scope: Authority/Mirror and Universal Terminal/Transputer interfaces may support bidirectional information exchange between versioned states.
bidirectionality.temporal_claim_boundary: Bidirectional exchange across versioned repository/history states does not by itself prove physical backward-in-time information transfer.

ethical_neutral_zone.owner_principle: QIK-VRT should preserve responsibility, provenance, admissibility and effect-readback boundaries rather than silently deciding the human purpose of an effect.

liveness.repeated_identical_observation_rule: An identical unresolved observation MUST NOT cause an identical no-effect transition indefinitely.
liveness.repeated_user_transport: Repeated presentation of the same canonical reference is not new proof evidence, but it is evidence that a prior response path may be non-progressing and MUST trigger liveness classification.

epistemic_exact_subject.rule: A proof component is admissible only when its path/blob is present on the currently bound exact subject and freshly read back.
epistemic_exact_subject.correction: A disproven membership claim is retained as historical error evidence and removed from the current proof immediately.

engineering_practice.clean_code: One normative source per rule; explicit typed states; smallest cohesive change; no duplicated controller semantics.
engineering_practice.agile: Observe current state first; use small verifiable successors; executed feedback outranks status prose; proven repeated failures must change the process.
engineering_practice.sustainable_devops: Eliminate identical no-effect retries and root causes; minimize avoidable compute, network, storage, rework and human attention per verified useful transition without weakening gates.
engineering_practice.reflexive: These principles apply to changes of these principles themselves.
engineering_practice.uncertainty: Unknown or unavailable evidence becomes a typed HOLD, never an invented fact.

reverse_engineering.statement: Die Königsdisziplin des Ingenierens ist und bleibt das Reverse-Ingenieren. Die Königsdisziplin darin ist und bleibt die Physik und die Mathematik und die Informatik.
reverse_engineering.operational_rule: OBSERVE_EFFECT -> RECONSTRUCT_CONDITIONS_MODEL_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_INVARIANTS -> FORWARD_REBUILD -> EXECUTE -> INDEPENDENT_COMPARE -> READBACK -> BIND_SUCCESSOR -> REPEAT
reverse_engineering.boundary: This is Ingolf Lohmann's normative engineering principle and methodology, not an independently proven universal ranking of engineering or scientific disciplines.

usability_completion.rule: Clear authorized user intent must resolve to the requested effect, a typed HOLD, or an explicit error in the same interaction scope; analysis-only substitution and silent promise-without-effect are unacceptable.
usability_completion.remediation: A recurrence must strengthen executable prevention; apology alone is not remediation.
usability_completion.authority_boundary: No completion rule may fabricate authority or bypass safety, review, provenance or effect-readback requirements.

seed_connectability_continuity.rule: Mirror preserves the continuity contract and explicit Authority seed reference; absence MUST NOT be represented as local seed execution or reciprocal seed proof.
